channel.title: The Wang Report · Science and Health
channel.description: The Wang Report Science and Health desk: significant developments and optional features.

item.title: Over 3,000 people died of preventable cholera in nine months of 2026
item.description: Nearly nine in 10 deaths were in Africa, despite a reported decline in mortality from the preventable and treatable infection.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: Eight signals distinguished 80% of unique Firefox users in fingerprint study
item.description: Measurements from almost 25 million users show how changing a few browser signals can make people harder to distinguish, while leaving tracking prevention unproven.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: What one light-day means for contacting Voyager 1
item.description: At that distance from Earth, even an immediate reply would require roughly 48 hours of radio travel.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: New Webb method delivers two to fifteen times better sensitivity in tests
item.description: Researchers recovered a known planet at a previously undetected wavelength by modelling the telescope changes that leave stellar glare behind.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: Unverified reporting: Anthropic's 950-Agent Swarm Finds A New Enzyme In 21 Hours
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: Anthropic -- primary announcement of the ART enzyme discovery; TechCrunch -- reports the 950-agent, 21-hour discovery process and its limits; Forbes -- Anthropic's science lab reports finding a novel CRISPR-like enzyme. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: Anthropic's new life-sciences lab ran 950 AI agents against public DNA for 21 hours and flagged a genuinely new enzyme system, but no regulator yet knows how to audit a machine's own judgment about what counts as a discovery.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: 8.8 Million Adults Later, HHS's Ultra-Processed Definition Is Still in Review
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: BMJ Group -- press release detailing the 8.8-million-person dose-response meta-analysis and its risk figures; Medical Xpress -- coverage of the per-100g risk increases and stated limitations; News-Medical -- additional detail on cohort composition and effect sizes. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: The largest ultra-processed food study ever assembled found dose-dependent harm in 8.8 million adults, landing exactly as HHS decides whether the evidence is finally strong enough to regulate.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: Unverified reporting: The CAR-T That Ignores CD19 On Purpose
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: PeproMene Bio's release with full trial results, safety data and funding history; BioSpace confirms trial expansion, named investigators, expansion-cohort result; PubMed indexes the Lancet research letter with named authors. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: PeproMene Bio's BAFF-R CAR-T put seven of nine relapsed lymphoma patients into remission, showing that switching the target antigen, not re-dosing it, may be what rescues CAR-T failures.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: A Second CAR-T Target Rescues Relapsed Patients
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: PR Newswire -- PeproMene Bio's release detailing the Lancet publication, trial numbers and safety data; BioSpace -- mirrored company release with trial and institutional detail; LA Business Journal -- $40.2 million Series B raise, per SEC filings. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: A Phase 1 trial rescued lymphoma patients whose CD19 CAR-T had already failed with a second target, BAFF-R, though nine patients isn't proof it scales.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: Unverified reporting: A Single Gene Edit Holds At One Year
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: CRISPR Therapeutics Presents Phase 1a Data for CTX310 at ESC Congress 2026; Durability of CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing Targeting ANGPTL3 with CTX310; Cleveland Clinic First In Human CRISPR Trial Lowers Cholesterol and Triglycerides for a Full Year. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: CRISPR Therapeutics' one-time liver edit kept cholesterol and triglycerides down a year after infusion, proving durability for the first time, though the company's own protocol tracks these patients for years past this readout.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: Moderna's $45 Billion Bet On A Sealed Number
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: Merck.com -- Phase 3 INTerpath-001 topline results; BioPharma Dive -- trial size, Phase 2 data, analyst benchmarks; STAT News -- companies withheld detailed efficacy data. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: Wall Street revalued Moderna by $45 billion on a topline label alone, and the number that would actually justify that move stays sealed until October.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: A Demo Video Doing A Prospectus's Job
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: CNBC -- Unitree prices IPO at $9 billion valuation; Domain-b (via Reuters) -- IPO pricing, oversubscription, revenue, debut window; Unite.AI -- DeepSeek's stake and embodied-AI partnership terms. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: Deep Robotics timed a single-take video of a robot climbing stairs to the week China's humanoid IPO mania peaked, because four units sold in two years can't do that job.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: Fugaku Lost To A Seven-Hour Quantum Run
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: IBM Newsroom; Next Platform; IBM Quantum Blog. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: IBM's open Quantum Advantage Tracker matters less as proof quantum computers won and more as published circuits that more than 30 outside teams have now tried, and failed, to break.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: A Stablecoin Issuer Becomes A Neurotech Funder
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: Tether Evo Publishes Three Peer Reviewed Brain Computer Interface Studies. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: Tether, the company behind the world's largest stablecoin, has quietly become a serious funder of brain implants for paralysis, and its reserve-driven balance sheet may outlast biotech's usual venture cycle.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: The Rocket Problem Just Became A Starship Factory Problem
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: SpaceNews -- SpaceX conducts 13th Starship test flight; Fortune -- SpaceX Starship V3 launch, best reentry and splashdown; Engadget -- SpaceX 13th Starship flight test, Starlink next-gen satellites. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: Starship's 13th flight proved the ship survives and the payload works in the same mission, which means the real bottleneck now sits in the satellite factory, not the rocket.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: China's Brain Chip Market Outruns Its Patients
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: MIT Technology Review -- NMPA's March 2026 commercial approval and device specs; South China Morning Post -- Huashan Hospital implant procedure; Bird & Bird -- 48-hour reimbursement code and regulatory pathway. Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: Neuracle's brain implant has treated 32 patients and earned zero revenue, yet Beijing built a reimbursement code, and Neuracle filed a $345m IPO, faster than the clinical evidence justifies.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Unverified reporting: Brain Implants Are Not All Equally Hard
item.description: Unverified reporting: No current, complete source review supports this version; Independent editorial review is missing, incomplete or stale. Attribution: Brain Implant Restores Sense of Touch in Quadriplegic Patient (STAT); China Implants First Commercial Brain Computer Interface in Crash Victim (TechRadar); BrainCo Demonstrates Mind Controlled Robot Link at China's World AI Conference (South China Morning Post). Material claims have not been independently confirmed. Source verification remains incomplete. Unverified reporting, attributed to Wang Report: This week paired a bidirectional touch-restoring brain implant with China's first commercial brain-computer interface, and the commercial one, despite the bigger headline, is solving the easier engineering problem.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield
